dog.description_text:
Well, butter my biscuits! This sweet little Southern gentleman made his way all the way from Alabama after being flown to safety ahead of Hurricane Isaias. His journey to ARF helped make room for other pups in need in the storm’s aftermath, and now this precious boy is hoping his next big adventure will lead him straight to his forever family.

Biscuit is a shy little fella who’s still learning that the world ain’t such a scary place after all. He’ll need a patient, gentle family willing to give him the time and space he needs to come out of his shell. No rushing this biscuit out of the oven! He might not be the first pup to come running up for a hug, but with a little kindness and a whole lot of love, we’re hoping this Southern gentleman will soon be feelin’ right at home.

They say after every storm comes a rainbow, and we sure hope Biscuit’s rainbow is waiting in the form of a family who sees just how special he is. Biscuit’s ready to trade stormy skies for blue skies and find his happily ever after.
